evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Automatic translation quality metrics trained on general-domain corpora systematically fail on social media content, where communicative intent is encoded in culturally loaded expressions (internet slang, homophonic ciphers, and platform-specific idioms) rather than surface token patterns.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: On a 1,444-sample human-annotated social media translation benchmark, Qwen3-8B trained with CuRIL achieves Cohen's kappa 0.370 and Exact Match accuracy of 45.22%, approaching Gemini-3.1-Pro with 30x fewer parameters and surpassing models up to 235B in scale.
